author: kdlong
body:
#### PR description:

Sherpa writes four weights per event: `Weight` (nominal), `MEWeight`, `WeightNormalisation` and `NTrials`. `SherpaHadronizer` writes their names into the `GenLumiInfoHeader` only if the fragment has a `SherpaWeightsBlock`. The three Sherpa relval fragments don't have one, so their weights have no names.

This PR adds to each fragment:

- a `SherpaWeightsBlock` listing the four weights, with the nominal first. The run cards have no scale or PDF variations, so `SherpaVariationWeights` is empty.
- `HEPMC_USE_NAMED_WEIGHTS=1` in the run card, so that Sherpa stores the weights under these names and the hadronizer can find them by name.

The nominal weight is unchanged. Only configuration files are changed. On master, nothing reads these names yet, so this makes no difference to the workflows or their output. It is needed for #52288.

#### PR validation:

On master, this PR makes no difference: nothing reads the Sherpa weight names yet, and 534, 536 and 573 run the same with or without it. The three fragments were checked to load correctly.

The test that matters was done with #52288, which requires every weight to have a name when using strict error checking (`allowUnassociatedWeights=False`). With #52288 alone, workflows 534, 536 and 573 stop with "Found more than 2 weights ... no weight groups". With #52288 and this PR, they pass (step 1, 10 events), with all four weights named.

Not a backport. Needed by #52288.
